Hi Sarah — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and suggested next step: a 60–90 minute ops & infra deep-dive with our ML infra leads so we can validate capacity, network egress, and data path assumptions. Goal is to confirm: 1) expected QPS and latency SLOs, 2) data residency and KMS flow, and 3) model variants and quantization trade-offs for your workload.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Dec 21: 10:00–11:30
- Wed Dec 22: 14:00–15:30
- Thu Dec 23: 09:00–10:30

Please let us know which works best and who from your side should join (infra/DBA/security). I’ve attached a one-page draft agenda (tdx-agenda-v1.pdf).

Next steps we’ll take after the call: produce a short mutual action plan and a rough cost/throughput estimate for the pilot.

Thanks,
